scope: A production MarketDataFreshnessProbe backed by SRS-MD-003's HeartbeatFreshnessMonitor, consulted by the live order path (route_order) and the paper order path (dispatch_order), so that stale subscribed data blocks submissions with MARKET_DATA_STALE and fresh data resumes them. Unblocks the live execution host's ib tier (crates/atp-orchestrator/src/bin/live_execution_host.rs:189), which refuses to start without a non-fixture probe. Also closes ERR-3's paper half (crates/atp-execution/src/order_routing.rs:197).

obligations.criterion: Given a subscribed instrument whose combined line freshness from HeartbeatFreshnessMonitor is older than the 15 s staleness threshold, the production probe reports it stale; after a tick newer than the threshold it reports it fresh. Exercised with an injected clock, no sleeps.

Given the probe reports an instrument stale, a live submission for it through route_order returns MARKET_DATA_STALE and the broker test double records zero submit calls; given it reports fresh, the same submission reaches the broker double exactly once.

Given the probe reports an instrument stale, a paper submission for it through dispatch_order returns MARKET_DATA_STALE, produces no simulated fill, and creates no IB order; after the probe reports fresh, the next paper submission is accepted and filled by the simulator.

With SRS-MD-003's monitor fed by a real IB paper-gateway subscription, holding the feed for longer than 15 s makes live and paper submissions return MARKET_DATA_STALE, and restoring it makes the next submissions succeed.
Verify acceptance criteria: While subscribed market data is stale, live and paper order submissions return MARKET_DATA_STALE; submissions resume when fresh data is received.

completion_evidence: tools/evidence.py run SRS-MD-004 --obligation C1|C2|C3 -- <the listed test>, each exit 0 at the evidenced commit
an approving tools/adversarial_review.py round at that commit (the reviewer receives this contract)
agent_pool.py integrate SRS-MD-004 --mode implemented, which re-runs C1-C3 itself
limitations: C1 and C3 name tests this feature must add; they do not exist yet.
I1 needs an operator-gated IB paper-gateway window and is not a component criterion.
